sources.name: NASA FIRMS MODIS Collection 6.1 Standard Processing (MCD14ML)
sources.temporal_coverage: Terra: 2000-11-01 to ~2025-12 wind-down; Aqua: 2002-07-04 to 2026 SP cutoff (2-5 month SP lag)
sources.spatial_resolution: 1000 m nadir (up to 4.8 km x 2.0 km at 55 deg scan edge)
sources.role: primary historical observation (must split Terra vs Aqua on ingestion)
sources.schema_notes: 15 CSV columns including brightness (Ch21/22 K), bright_t31 (Ch31 K), integer confidence (0-100), satellite ('T'/'A' in archive or 'Terra'/'Aqua' in API), and type (0=vegetation fire, 1=volcano, 2=static land/industrial, 3=offshore).
sources.orbital_drift_warning: Non-stationary post-2022 local crossing times: Terra exited Morning Constellation Oct 2022 (lowered to 694 km) and drifted from 10:30 AM toward ~09:00 AM MLT by Dec 2025; Aqua exited A-Train early 2022 and drifted from 13:30 PM to ~15:50 PM MLT by Aug 2026.
sources.requires: free FIRMS MAP_KEY (or async FIRMS Archive Download)

sources.name: NASA FIRMS MODIS Collection 6.1 Near Real-Time (MCD14DL)
sources.temporal_coverage: Recent 2-5 month tail after MODIS_SP max_date (confirm active platform cutoff via /api/data_availability)
sources.schema_notes: 14 CSV columns in Area API (type column is OMITTED in NRT; version='6.1NRT'/'6.1URT'). Never mix silently on dates covered by MODIS_SP.

sources.name: NASA FIRMS VIIRS Suomi-NPP 375 m Standard Processing (VNP14IMGML)
sources.temporal_coverage: 2012-01-20 to 2026-11-02T13:00:00Z (CLOSED HISTORICAL ARCHIVE; S-NPP science data permanently terminated Nov 2, 2026)
sources.spatial_resolution: 375 m nominal (3-zone aggregation; FRP from co-located 750 m M13)
sources.schema_notes: 15 CSV columns in SP: bright_ti4 (I4 K, saturates 367 K day), bright_ti5 (I5 K), categorical confidence ('l'/'n'/'h'), satellite ('N'), version ('2.0'), and type (0,1,2,3). Filter nighttime 'l' in South Atlantic Anomaly.
sources.orbital_phasing_notes: 13:30 asc / 01:30 desc (~833 km). Flew ~50 min opposite NOAA-20 pre-2024 and ~24-30 min quarter-orbit between NOAA-21 and NOAA-20 from Apr 2024 until Nov 2, 2026 shutdown.
sources.requires: free FIRMS MAP_KEY (or async FIRMS Archive Download)

sources.name: NASA FIRMS VIIRS NOAA-20 (JPSS-1) 375 m Standard Processing (VJ114IMGML)
sources.role: primary operational VIIRS standard record (omitted in initial datasets.json)
sources.schema_notes: 15 CSV columns in SP (type included); satellite='N20' or '1'; categorical confidence ('l'/'n'/'h').
sources.orbital_phasing_notes: 13:30 asc / 01:30 desc (~833 km), separated by ~50-51 min (180 deg half-orbit) from NOAA-21.
sources.requires: free FIRMS MAP_KEY (or async FIRMS Archive Download)

sources.name: NASA FIRMS VIIRS NOAA-20 (JPSS-1) 375 m Near Real-Time (VJ114IMGTDL_NRT)

sources.schema_notes: 14 CSV columns in Area API (type column omitted; impute static industrial/volcanic mask from multi-year SP type in {1,2,3}).

sources.temporal_coverage: 2024-01-17 to 2026 SP cutoff (verified live in FIRMS Area API source selector Nov 12, 2026)
sources.role: primary operational VIIRS standard record (2024+, omitted in initial datasets.json)
sources.schema_notes: 15 CSV columns in SP; satellite='N21' or '2'; categorical confidence ('l'/'n'/'h').
sources.orbital_phasing_notes: 13:30 asc / 01:30 desc (~833 km), ~50-51 min half-orbit separated from NOAA-20.

sources.temporal_coverage: Recent tail after VIIRS_NOAA21_SP max_date to present (operational)

sources.name: NASA FIRMS Asynchronous Bulk Archive Download
sources.temporal_coverage: 2000-11-01 to present across MODIS C6.1, VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21

sources.name: NASA Common Metadata Repository (CMR) Granule Search API
sources.temporal_coverage: 2000-present across MOD14, MYD14, VNP14IMG, VJ114IMG, VJ214IMG, MOD35_L2, MYD35_L2
sources.role: millisecond unauthenticated overpass footprint polygons, UTC times, day/night flag, and MOD35/MYD35 daytime swath cloud percentages
sources.schema_notes: Verified live 159-399 ms latency without authentication. Note: L2 fire products (MOD14/VNP14IMG) return CloudCover=null; query MOD35_L2/MYD35_L2 UMM-JSON AdditionalAttributes (CloudCoverPct250m, ClearPct250m) for daytime granule cloud summary.

sources.name: NASA LPCLOUD L3 Daily/8-Day 1 km Sinusoidal Active Fire & Cloud Mask Tiles (MOD14A1, MYD14A1, VNP14A1, VJ114A1, VJ214A1)
sources.spatial_resolution: 1000 m Sinusoidal grid (10 deg x 10 deg tiles, e.g., h08v05)
sources.role: sub-megabyte pixel-exact cloud mask (class 4) and verified clear-sky non-fire negative (class 5) grids
sources.schema_notes: Verified CMR sizes: 0.15-0.20 MB/day (VIIRS) and 0.73-0.78 MB/8-days (MODIS), reducing storage >1,000x compared to raw VNP03IMG + MOD35_L2 swaths.

sources.name: NASA LPCLOUD VIIRS 750 m M-Band Active Fire Swaths (VNP14, VJ114, VJ214)
sources.role: optional spatial-scale bridge isolating 375 m I-band vs 750 m M-band sensitivity on identical orbits
sources.requires: Earthdata Login for granule files (CMR metadata is public)

sources.name: NASA FIRMS Landsat 8/9 OLI 30 m Active Fire (US & Canada)
sources.role: high-resolution partial independent check for AOI-1 (California) and AOI-3 (Alberta)

sources.name: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) WMTS
sources.role: interactive map browse tiles for visual context and cloud-obscuration inspection (never training truth)

sources.name: MODIS/VIIRS Climate Modeling Grid (MOD14CMG/MYD14CMG/VNP14CMG) & GFED5NRT
